formationProjection: From both TRAIN cases read four replayTrace.source and replayTrace.assumptions in source order. Supply only these two fields per start to every former. No demonstration target, operation ID, intermediate steps, trace ID, structural cluster, expected answers or evaluation task enters any former. The common public macro-primitives/v1 mapping is visible independently of demonstrations.
grammar: Use the real AstRewriteTransformationEngine with all 6 profile operations and their mapped default rules, sorted by rule ID; max AST growth 16 and 120 generated moves per queried expression. At each start expand breadth-first paths of concrete depth one and two only; query the root once and at most 12 unique first-step edges in lexical ruleId, transformedExpression, applicationKey order. Require construction-equivalence, covered assumptions and no repeated formatted expression inside a path. Deduplicate the same concrete rule and endpoint at each parent. Map a concrete rule with multiple abstract labels to the lexicographically first. An eligible macro path must have exactly two concrete steps with two distinct successive abstract operation labels. Keep every generated legal path and count engine expansions and generated transitions, including rejected edges.
choice: Give every arm the identical independently generated open path universe for each start. Select at most one two-step path per start per campaign. Production ranks by the existing ExpressionScorer.weightedTotal of the endpoint, then lexical concrete rule/path key; ordered enumeration selects the first lexical path, including all legal alternatives in the retained enumeration; random uniformly selects an index from the same ordered legal paths. Key is JSON encoding of [concrete rule IDs, intermediate and final expression]. One Java Random stream per campaign, first 64 bits of the #383 campaign seed digest, frozen input order. No draw on empty path universe. No hidden best-of or outcome-conditioned choice.
generalization: After all four paths have been selected, give the existing production CandidateIndependentReusableMacroAdapter.form only self-generated start/endpoint/abstract-operation triples and source assumptions with synthetic path IDs. Group selected paths by abstract operation sequence in first-emission order. Invoke the same actual replay/generalizer once per group for every arm, retain failures and only accept SELECTED groups. Deduplicate accepted macro IDs in first-emission order; freeze every run's complete accepted set and rejected groups with a content digest before opening any evaluation task. Empty candidate sets remain empty.
evaluation: Use the actual existing paired macro utility evaluator on all twelve unchanged tasks across the six #383 cases, every arm and every campaign. Each comparison uses that task's original assumptions, search budget and target in evaluation only. Compare the frozen entire candidate set with the primitive-only baseline. Retain every paired outcome, exact path, rule IDs, expanded/generated counts, budget and correctness regression. Empty sets must retain every task, including native baseline results. No post-freeze candidate selection.
work: Aligned target-blind grammar expansion ceilings per start, one selected path per start, one shared generalizer per distinct selected sequence, and unchanged task-specific paired search budgets. This compares ranking policies in a shared production path/generalization pipeline. The reference and random policies are distinct; no claim of equal total compute, generalized macro rediscovery, universal utility or external novelty.
claimBoundary: Prospectively recorded measurement on an already public panel. Previous demonstrated-path macro experiments are separate. No demonstration labels or targets are inputs to any formation arm of this comparison.
